title: Reliability-Engineering Beta-Factor Model for Estimating Common-Cause Failure Fraction in Model Panels

original_idea.body:
# Reliability-Engineering Beta-Factor Model

Transfer the reliability-engineering beta-factor; on labeled safety judgments estimate each model's marginal failure rate and the all-models-failing-together rate, then fit a beta factor quantifying the shared-failure fraction for same-lineage vs mixed panels. Inference + statistical fit.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Level 4: strong chain — a beta-factor makes systemic AI redundancy risk legible in regulators' existing reliability language.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Level 5: estimate marginal + joint failure rates, fit a beta factor; ideal for a stats background, beginner-accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Level 5: tightly scoped single estimate (beta factor mono vs mixed) with clear success criteria.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Level 4: public models + labeled data, regulator-legible metric labs underweight, no internal access.

novelty.reasoning: A reliability-engineering beta-factor for LLM panels appears largely novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: No known beta-factor common-cause-failure estimate for LLM panels.
